Data is pooled across years - original had 4 samples per treatment but these were pooled to 2 samples
Tables contain both target mineral data (Tables 3, 4) and non-target nutritional data (Tables 1, 2)
Small sample size due to pooling may affect statistical power
AMBI clearly defined as ambient control, FACE as elevated treatment

recon.variance_source: PSEM values shown in all tables, defined in statistical analysis section as pooled standard error of mean
recon.treatment_definition: Free air carbon dioxide enrichment (FACE): 550 ppm atmospheric CO2
recon.sample_size_source: Because of small sample amounts for additional analysis, the four individual samples had to be pooled for two samples per CO2 and N treatment combination
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract mineral data from Tables 3 and 4 only. For each mineral, extract data for both N50 and N100 fertilization levels separately, comparing AMBI vs FACE within each N level. Use PSEM values as standard errors. Ignore Tables 1 and 2 as they contain nutritional composition data, not target mineral concentrations. Be careful to extract the correct species (wheat from Table 3, barley from Table 4).

table_descriptions.Table 1: Chemical composition of winter wheat grain - contains crude protein, fiber, starch, sugars, viscosity
table_descriptions.Table 2: Chemical composition of winter barley grain - contains crude protein, fiber, starch, sugars, viscosity
table_descriptions.Table 3: Elemental composition of winter wheat - contains Na, Zn, Cu, Mn, Fe concentrations
table_descriptions.Table 4: Elemental composition of winter barley - contains Na, Zn, Cu, Mn, Fe concentrations
